_comment: Microsoft Defender -> DefectDojo. Copy to /etc/vulnagent/defender.json with mode 0600 (it holds secrets). Keys starting with _ are ignored.

defectdojo._api_token: DefectDojo user menu -> API v2 Key. Can also come from env DD_API_TOKEN.

_client_id: Optional: one multi-tenant app registration shared by all customers (partner access). Leave empty if every customer has its own app.
_product_name: DefectDojo product per device. {host} = device DNS name, {short} = short name, {customer} = customer name. Product names must be unique in DefectDojo, so keep {customer} in it.
_skip_inactive_days: Devices Defender has not seen for this many days are not uploaded (0 = upload all)

customers.name: Contoso
customers._client_id: The customer's app registration (Application/client ID) and secret value. 'env:NAME' reads the secret from an environment variable.
customers._product_type: DefectDojo product type for this customer's devices (defaults to the name)
